rules.rule: the last line is the last line
rules.evil: The cursor can rest on the empty line after a file's final newline: G, 5j, w, }, dd, dk, dG, L, C-d and gj all reach it, and j there succeeds.
rules.die_vim: As in Vim: motions stop on the last line, j and gj on it signal an error, and a macro ends at that error.

cases.note: Vim's line, Evil's column: die-vim keeps the column after dk (S5 row 2)
Vim's line, Evil's column: die-vim keeps the column after dG (S5 row 2)
Vim stays on the last line without an error
the macro ends one repetition earlier, where j fails on the last line
the recursion ends where j fails on the last line

rules.rule: a count before / finds the nth match
rules.die_vim: As in Vim: 2/x goes to the second match.

rules.rule: an empty search repeats the last one
rules.die_vim: As in Vim: /<CR> searches for the last pattern again.

rules.rule: . inside a macro repeats the macro's change
rules.evil: . signals an error inside a macro, since Evil runs macros without command hooks.
rules.die_vim: As in Vim: . repeats the last change made inside the macro.

rules.rule: Vp on the last line replaces the line
rules.evil: Vp on the last line leaves an empty line and drops the final newline.
rules.die_vim: As in Vim: the line is replaced and the final newline stays.

rules.evil: 3H goes to the fourth line of the window.
rules.die_vim: As in Vim: 3H goes to the third line. H, M and L otherwise follow Evil (S5 row 20).

rules.rule: undo is Vim's u and C-r
rules.evil: Your Evil has no redo (evil-undo-system is unset): C-r signals an error, and u after another command redoes, as Emacs's undo chain does.
rules.die_vim: Your S5 answer: u steps back and C-r steps forward, as in Vim (scope §10).
DIE's regex syntax is Rust's (D4): the same change is :s/(foo) (bar)/$2 $1/, with the same result.

rules.evil: In emacs-lisp-mode and python-mode, a new line is indented by the language.
rules.die_vim: Until file-type modes (M1) give die-vim a language's indentation, a new line is indented like the line above, as Evil does in text.
